chat.permission.allowAlways.description..en: Do not ask again for the same permission request
chat.permission.allowAlways.description..zh: 后续相同权限请求不再询问

chat.permission.denyAlways.description.c.en: Always reject the same command in the future
chat.permission.denyAlways.description.c.zh: 后续相同命令也会直接拒绝

chat.permission.denyAlways.description.f.en: Always reject the same file operation in the future
chat.permission.denyAlways.description.f.zh: 后续相同文件操作也会直接拒绝

chat.permission.denyAlways.description.g.en: Always reject the same permission request in the future
chat.permission.denyAlways.description.g.zh: 后续相同权限请求也会直接拒绝

chat.captcha.verifyFailed.en: Captcha verification failed. Please try again.
chat.captcha.verifyFailed.zh: 验证码校验失败，请重试。

chat.cuaReadiness.toolsNotLoaded.en: ZCode Computer Use is still preparing — its tools aren't loaded yet ({count} loaded). Grant the permissions below; tools appear once the helper is ready.
chat.cuaReadiness.toolsNotLoaded.zh: ZCode 电脑控制仍在准备中——工具尚未加载（已加载 {count} 个）。请先授予下方权限，Helper 就绪后工具会自动出现。

chat.cuaReadiness.toolsPreparing.en: ZCode Computer Use is still preparing — its tools aren't loaded yet. Grant the permissions below; tools appear once the helper is ready.
chat.cuaReadiness.toolsPreparing.zh: ZCode 电脑控制仍在准备中——工具尚未加载。请先授予下方权限，Helper 就绪后工具会自动出现。

chat.toolCall.cua.requestAccess.zh: 检查 Computer Use 权限

chat.toolCall.cua.details.changeCounts.zh: 新增 {added} 项，移除 {removed} 项

chat.toolCall.cua.details.appsFound.zh: 找到 {count} 个运行中的应用

chat.toolCall.cua.details.elementStaleRe.en: The interface changed and the original element is no longer available.
chat.toolCall.cua.details.elementStaleRe.zh: 界面已发生变化，原来的元素不再可用。

chat.toolCall.cua.details.elementStaleAc.en: Read the app interface again, then select the target from the new state.
chat.toolCall.cua.details.elementStaleAc.zh: 重新读取应用界面，然后从新状态中选择目标元素。

startup.global.servicesFailed.en: Local data is ready, but app services failed to start. Copy the diagnostics, then exit and reopen ZCode.
startup.global.servicesFailed.zh: 本地数据准备已完成，但应用服务启动失败。请复制诊断信息，退出并重新打开 ZCode。

startup.global.help.en: ZCode will open when preparation finishes. Large histories may take longer. Please keep the app running.
startup.global.help.zh: 准备完成后将自动进入 ZCode。历史记录较多时可能需要较长时间，请保持应用运行。

startup.global.copyFailed.en: Copy failed. Please note the diagnostic ID.
startup.global.copyFailed.zh: 复制失败，请记录诊断 ID。

startup.global.error.storage_full.en: Storage is full or a capacity limit was reached. Check the drives containing your data and system temporary directories. Free space or adjust the quota, then retry.
startup.global.error.storage_full.zh: 存储空间不足或已达到容量限制，无法完成数据更新。请检查数据目录及系统临时目录所在磁盘的可用空间，释放空间或调整存储额度后重试。

startup.global.error.permission_denied.en: The database is not writable. Check permissions for the data and temporary directories, then retry.
startup.global.error.permission_denied.zh: 无法写入数据库。请检查数据目录及临时目录的访问权限，处理后点击重试。

startup.global.error.io_error.en: Database I/O failed. Check the disk or storage connection, then retry.
startup.global.error.io_error.zh: 读写数据库失败。请检查磁盘或存储连接是否正常，处理后点击重试。

startup.global.error.out_of_memory.en: A memory allocation failed while preparing data. Close other apps to free memory, then retry.
startup.global.error.out_of_memory.zh: 数据更新时内存分配失败。请关闭其他应用，释放内存后重试。

startup.global.error.corrupt.en: The database appears damaged. Preserve your data and diagnostics and contact support. Do not delete the database.
startup.global.error.corrupt.zh: 数据库无法通过完整性检查。请保留数据和诊断信息，联系支持人员处理；不要删除数据库。

startup.global.error.checksum_mismatch.en: The migration records do not match this app version. Preserve your data and diagnostics and contact support.
startup.global.error.checksum_mismatch.zh: 数据库迁移记录与当前程序不匹配。请保留数据和诊断信息，联系支持人员处理。

startup.global.error.open_failed.en: The database could not be opened. Check that the data directory exists and is accessible, then retry.
startup.global.error.open_failed.zh: 无法打开数据库。请检查数据目录是否存在且可访问，处理后点击重试。

startup.global.error.lock_timeout.en: Waiting for the database write lock timed out. Another ZCode or CLI process may be updating data. Retry after it finishes.
startup.global.error.lock_timeout.zh: 等待数据库写锁超时。请检查其他 ZCode 或 CLI 进程是否仍在更新数据，待其完成后点击重试。

startup.global.error.sql_failed.en: Preparation did not finish. Copy the diagnostics and check the logs. Resolve the issue, then retry manually. The app will not retry automatically.
startup.global.error.sql_failed.zh: 准备过程未完成。请复制诊断信息查看日志，排除问题后手动重试。应用不会自动重试。

startup.global.error.startup_status_time.en: No startup status was received. Exit and reopen ZCode. If it fails again, provide the diagnostics to support.
startup.global.error.startup_status_time.zh: 未能收到启动状态。请退出并重新打开 ZCode；如果仍失败，请提供诊断信息。

startup.global.error.transport_closed.en: The preparation process exited or disconnected. Exit and reopen ZCode to check the migration records again.
startup.global.error.transport_closed.zh: 数据准备进程意外退出或连接中断。请退出并重新打开 ZCode，应用会重新检查迁移记录。

startup.global.error.unsupported_runtime.en: The configured Agent does not support storage preparation. Restore the bundled Agent, then reopen ZCode.
startup.global.error.unsupported_runtime.zh: 当前配置的 Agent 不支持独立存储准备。请恢复配套的 Agent 后重新打开 ZCode。

startup.database.waiting_for_lock.en: Waiting for another window to prepare data
startup.database.waiting_for_lock.zh: 数据库正被其他进程使用，正在等待

startup.database.help.en: The workspace will open when ready. Keep the app running.
startup.database.help.zh: 准备完成后将自动进入工作区，请保持应用运行。

startup.database.failedHelp.en: The original database has been preserved. Check diagnostic logs, resolve the issue, and retry.
startup.database.failedHelp.zh: 原数据库已保留。请查看诊断日志，排除问题后重试。

startup.database.longRunning.en: Large histories can take longer. The app is still waiting for the database to finish.
startup.database.longRunning.zh: 历史数据较多时可能需要较长时间，应用仍在等待数据库完成。

rewards.loadFailed.en: Unable to load this page. Please retry.

bashOutput.error.unsupported.en: This runtime does not support background output
bashOutput.error.unsupported.zh: 当前运行时不支持查看后台输出

bashOutput.error.read_failed.en: Could not read the output file

bashOutput.error.query_failed.en: Could not connect to the task runtime
bashOutput.error.query_failed.zh: 无法连接到任务运行时

bots.runtime.deliveryFailedDescription.en: The message could not be delivered. Share the details below for troubleshooting. This notice clears after the next successful send.
bots.runtime.deliveryFailedDescription.zh: 消息未能送达，请提供以下错误详情以便排查。下一次发送成功后，此提示会自动清除。

bots.description.en: Connect external chats and webhooks to ZCode bots.
bots.description.zh: 把外部聊天工具和 Webhook 接入 ZCode 机器人。

bots.setup.bindDescription.en: Create a bind code, then send the bind command in the bot private chat.
bots.setup.bindDescription.zh: 生成绑定码后，在对应机器人私聊里发送绑定命令。

bots.setup.bindExpiresIn.zh: 绑定码将在 {time} 后失效

bots.setup.bindRegenerating.en: Bind code expired. Creating a new one...
bots.setup.bindRegenerating.zh: 绑定码已失效，正在重新生成…

bots.setup.bound.en: {count} user(s) bound. Continue to configure this bot.
bots.setup.bound.zh: 已绑定 {count} 个用户，可以继续设置机器人。

bots.setup.allowedAllDescription.en: This bot can use every configured workspace.
bots.setup.allowedAllDescription.zh: 当前机器人允许使用配置中的所有 workspace。

bots.setupDescription.chooseBot.en: Choose the third-party chat bot to connect.
bots.setupDescription.chooseBot.zh: 选择要接入的第三方聊天机器人。

bots.setupDescription.createBot.en: Enter bot or webhook credentials. The next step tests connectivity first.
bots.setupDescription.createBot.zh: 填写机器人或 webhook 凭据，下一步会先测试连通性。

bots.setupDescription.bindBot.en: Create a bind code and bind the account in the bot private chat.
bots.setupDescription.bindBot.zh: 生成绑定码并在机器人私聊中完成账号绑定。

bots.setupDescription.setBot.en: Set the default context, allowed workspaces, and third-party reply detail.
bots.setupDescription.setBot.zh: 设置默认上下文、允许的 workspace 和第三方回复颗粒度。

bots.setup.guide.createNote.en: Prepare the third-party side first, then come back and click Test and continue.
bots.setup.guide.createNote.zh: 先按右侧步骤在第三方平台准备好凭据，再回来点“测试并继续”。

bots.setup.callbackUrlDescription.webhoo.en: Your external system should send inbound message callbacks to this address. Asynchronous outbound replies still use the Webhook URL entered on the left.
bots.setup.callbackUrlDescription.webhoo.zh: 外部系统向这个地址发送入站消息回调。出站回复仍然走你在左侧填写的 Webhook URL。

bots.setup.callbackUrlDescription.webhoo.en: Webhook binding uses the same endpoint: send a private callback request here with text = /bind <code>.
bots.setup.callbackUrlDescription.webhoo.zh: Webhook 绑定时，也是在这个地址上发送 text = /bind <code> 的私聊回调请求。

bots.setup.guide.telegram.create.1.en: Open @BotFather in Telegram and create a new bot.
bots.setup.guide.telegram.create.1.zh: 在 Telegram 中打开 @BotFather，创建一个新机器人。

bots.setup.guide.telegram.create.2.en: Copy the HTTP API token returned by BotFather and paste it into this form.
bots.setup.guide.telegram.create.2.zh: 复制 BotFather 返回的 HTTP API Token，并粘贴到当前表单。

bots.setup.guide.telegram.create.3.en: It helps to open the bot's private chat now because the bind command must be sent there.
bots.setup.guide.telegram.create.3.zh: 建议提前打开这个机器人的私聊窗口；后面绑定时要在私聊里发送绑定命令。

bots.setup.guide.telegram.bind.1.en: Return to Telegram and open the private chat with the bot you created.
bots.setup.guide.telegram.bind.1.zh: 回到 Telegram，打开刚创建的机器人私聊窗口。

bots.setup.guide.telegram.bind.2.en: If the chat has never started, press Start or send any message first, then send {command}.
bots.setup.guide.telegram.bind.2.zh: 如果还没开始过对话，先点 Start 或发任意一条消息，再发送 {command}。

bots.setup.guide.telegram.bind.3.en: Come back here after Telegram confirms the bind succeeded.
bots.setup.guide.telegram.bind.3.zh: 收到绑定成功提示后回到这里继续下一步。

bots.setup.guide.weixin.create.1.en: Start Weixin QR login, scan the QR code with Weixin, then confirm on your phone.
bots.setup.guide.weixin.create.1.zh: 点击微信扫码登录，用微信扫描二维码并在手机端确认。

bots.setup.guide.weixin.create.2.en: ZCode saves the bot_token returned by iLink automatically; after scanning, send any message to the bot in Weixin to activate the chat.
bots.setup.guide.weixin.create.2.zh: ZCode 会直接保存 iLink 返回的 bot_token；扫码后请在微信里向 Bot 发送任意消息完成会话激活。

bots.setup.guide.weixin.bind.1.en: Open the Weixin direct chat you want to bind.
bots.setup.guide.weixin.bind.1.zh: 在微信里打开要绑定的单聊。

bots.setup.guide.weixin.bind.3.en: Come back here after the bind succeeds to finish the workspace and CLI defaults.
bots.setup.guide.weixin.bind.3.zh: 看到绑定成功后回到这里继续配置默认 workspace 和 CLI。

bots.setup.guide.feishu.create.1.en: Create a self-built app in the Feishu/Lark developer console and enable bot capability.
bots.setup.guide.feishu.create.1.zh: 在飞书开放平台创建一个自建应用，并开启机器人能力。

bots.setup.guide.feishu.create.3.en: Choose the matching Feishu or Lark domain here, then paste the credentials into the form.
bots.setup.guide.feishu.create.3.zh: 选择与你的租户一致的 Feishu / Lark 域名，再把凭据填回当前表单。

bots.setup.guide.feishu.bind.1.en: Install the app into your tenant and open a direct chat with the bot.
bots.setup.guide.feishu.bind.1.zh: 把这个应用安装到你的飞书租户，并打开与该机器人的单聊窗口。

bots.setup.guide.feishu.bind.3.en: Return here after the bind succeeds to finish the workspace and CLI defaults.
bots.setup.guide.feishu.bind.3.zh: 看到绑定成功后回到这里继续配置默认 workspace 和 CLI。

bots.setup.guide.webhook.create.1.en: Webhook mode does not require a native bot in the third-party product; your integration only needs to POST messages to ZCode.
bots.setup.guide.webhook.create.1.zh: Webhook 模式不需要先在第三方平台创建原生机器人；你的系统只需要能向 ZCode 回调接口发消息。

bots.setup.guide.webhook.create.2.en: Set a shared secret first; add an outbound webhook URL as well if you want asynchronous replies pushed back.
bots.setup.guide.webhook.create.2.zh: 先约定一个共享 secret；如果你还想接收异步回复，再填一个出站 Webhook URL。

bots.setup.guide.webhook.create.3.en: Keep one stable userId per external user so binding and future context resolve to the same person.
bots.setup.guide.webhook.create.3.zh: 同一个外部用户要保持稳定的 userId，这样绑定和后续上下文才能对应到同一人。

bots.setup.footer.choose.en: Choose a supported bot to continue.
bots.setup.footer.choose.zh: 选择一个已支持的渠道后继续。

bots.setup.footer.create.zh: 测试通过后才会进入绑定步骤。

bots.setup.footer.bind.en: The bind code initially allows all workspaces; the final scope is saved next.
bots.setup.footer.bind.zh: 绑定码默认允许所有 workspace，最终范围在下一步保存。

bots.setup.footer.set.en: Finish enables the bot and returns it to the added list.
bots.setup.footer.set.zh: 完成后机器人会启用并出现在已添加列表。

bots.setup.discardDescription.en: This setup flow is not finished. The temporary bot will be deleted.
bots.setup.discardDescription.zh: 当前创建流程还没有完成，已创建的临时机器人会被删除。

bots.weixinBotTokenPlaceholder.en: Saved after QR login; you can also paste bot_token manually
bots.weixinBotTokenPlaceholder.zh: 扫码后自动保存，也可手动粘贴 bot_token

bots.feishuRegistrationDescription.en: Scan to create an app and save credentials.
bots.feishuRegistrationDescription.zh: 扫码创建应用并保存凭据。

bots.feishuRegistrationScanHint.en: Scan with Feishu/Lark and confirm app creation.
bots.feishuRegistrationScanHint.zh: 用飞书 / Lark 扫码并确认创建应用。

bots.feishuRegistrationScanHint.feishu.en: Scan with Feishu and confirm app creation.
bots.feishuRegistrationScanHint.feishu.zh: 用飞书扫码并确认创建应用。

bots.feishuRegistrationScanHint.lark.en: Scan with Lark and confirm app creation.
bots.feishuRegistrationScanHint.lark.zh: 用 Lark 扫码并确认创建应用。

bots.feishuRegistrationFailed.zh: 启动飞书扫码注册失败：{error}

bots.feishuRegistrationExpired.en: The QR code expired. Start again.
bots.feishuRegistrationExpired.zh: 二维码已过期，请重新开始。

bots.feishuRegistration.expired.en: The QR code expired. Start again.
bots.feishuRegistration.expired.zh: 二维码已过期，请重新开始。

bots.replyGranularity.assistantChanges.d.en: Send assistant text and file changes, without tool-call progress.
bots.replyGranularity.assistantChanges.d.zh: 回复助手正文和文件变更，隐藏工具调用过程。

bots.replyGranularity.assistantToolcalls.en: Send assistant text, tool-call progress, and file changes.
bots.replyGranularity.assistantToolcalls.zh: 回复助手正文、工具调用进度和文件变更。

bots.replyGranularity.summaryChanges.des.en: Send only the final result and change summary for quieter notifications.
bots.replyGranularity.summaryChanges.des.zh: 仅回复最终结果和文件变更摘要，适合低打扰通知。

bots.replyGranularity.streamingCard.desc.en: Feishu/Lark only support Card JSON 2.0 streaming cards, with tool calls shown only as collapsed summaries.
bots.replyGranularity.streamingCard.desc.zh: 飞书/Lark 仅支持基于 Card JSON 2.0 的流式卡片，工具调用只显示折叠摘要。

bots.newBot.description.en: Choose where this bot will receive messages. After selecting a channel, configure credentials, binding, allowed workspaces, and defaults.
bots.newBot.description.zh: 选择这个机器人接收消息的渠道。选择渠道后，再配置凭据、绑定、允许的 workspace 和默认上下文。

bots.newBot.selectProviderHint.en: Choose a channel on the right to create a bot.
bots.newBot.selectProviderHint.zh: 在右侧选择一个渠道来创建机器人。

bots.newBot.providerDescription.telegram.en: Create a bot, then bind by message.
bots.newBot.providerDescription.telegram.zh: 创建机器人，再消息绑定。

bots.newBot.providerDescription.weixin.en: Scan to log in; first message activates.
bots.newBot.providerDescription.weixin.zh: 扫码登录，首条消息激活。

bots.newBot.providerDescription.feishu.en: Scan to create an app, then bind by message.
bots.newBot.providerDescription.feishu.zh: 扫码创建应用，再消息绑定。

bots.newBot.providerDescription.lark.en: Scan to create an app, then bind by message.
bots.newBot.providerDescription.lark.zh: 扫码创建应用，再消息绑定。

bots.newBot.providerDescription.dingding.zh: 钉钉机器人集成规划中。

bots.newBot.providerDescription.webhook.en: Receive callbacks from your own system and optionally push replies back.
bots.newBot.providerDescription.webhook.zh: 从你的系统接收入站回调，并可配置出站回复。

bots.newBot.providerDescription.discord.zh: Discord 机器人集成规划中。

bots.newBot.providerDescription.wecom.zh: 企业微信机器人集成规划中。

bots.enabled.description.en: Turn this bot on or off and clear its runtime state.
bots.enabled.description.zh: 开启或关闭这个机器人，也可以清理它的运行状态。

bots.providerSettings.weixin.en: Credentials are saved after scan; the first Weixin message activates the chat.
bots.providerSettings.weixin.zh: 扫码后保存凭据，首条微信消息激活会话。

bots.providerSettings.webhook.en: Webhook uses a callback secret for inbound requests and an optional outbound URL for replies.
bots.providerSettings.webhook.zh: Webhook 使用回调密钥校验入站请求，也可以配置出站 URL 接收回复。

bots.providerSettings.discord.en: Discord support is not available yet.

bots.providerSettings.wecom.en: WeCom support is not available yet.
bots.providerSettings.wecom.zh: 企业微信暂未开放配置。

bots.weixinRegistrationDescription.en: Scan to log in, then send any message in Weixin to activate the chat.
bots.weixinRegistrationDescription.zh: 扫码登录后，在微信里发送任意消息激活会话。

bots.weixinRegistrationScanHint.en: Scan with Weixin and confirm login.
bots.weixinRegistrationScanHint.zh: 用微信扫码并确认登录。

bots.weixinRegistrationSuccess.en: Weixin bot linked. Send any message in Weixin to activate it.
bots.weixinRegistrationSuccess.zh: 微信机器人已关联，请在微信里发送任意消息激活

bots.weixinActivationHint.en: Send any message to the bot in Weixin; the first message will receive a welcome and command guide.
bots.weixinActivationHint.zh: 请在微信里向 Bot 发送任意消息；首次消息会收到欢迎和帮助。

bots.weixinRegistrationFailed.en: Failed to start Weixin QR login: {error}
bots.weixinRegistrationFailed.zh: 启动微信扫码登录失败：{error}

bots.weixinRegistration.expired.en: The QR code expired. Start again.
bots.weixinRegistration.expired.zh: 二维码已过期，请重新开始。

bots.botTokenDescription.webhook.en: Used to connect this webhook bot.
bots.botTokenDescription.webhook.zh: 用于连接这个 Webhook 机器人。

bots.telegramBotFatherScanHint.en: Scan to open BotFather, create a bot, and paste the token.
bots.telegramBotFatherScanHint.zh: 扫码打开 BotFather，创建机器人并粘贴 token。

bots.runtime.telegramLongPollingHandledE.en: Telegram long polling is handled by another ZCode window.
bots.runtime.telegramLongPollingHandledE.zh: Telegram 长轮询由另一个 ZCode 窗口处理。

bots.runtime.telegramPollingFailedRetryi.zh: Telegram 轮询失败，正在重试。

bots.runtime.boundConnectionInterruptedD.en: The bot is bound, but its persistent connection is interrupted.
bots.runtime.boundConnectionInterruptedD.zh: 机器人已绑定，但当前长连接中断。

bots.runtime.credentialsSavedConnectionF.en: App credentials are saved, but the persistent connection failed.
bots.runtime.credentialsSavedConnectionF.zh: 应用凭据已保存，但长连接失败。

bots.runtime.connectionBlocksBinding.en: The bot cannot receive messages, so binding is temporarily unavailable.
bots.runtime.connectionBlocksBinding.zh: 机器人当前无法接收消息，因此暂时不能完成绑定。

bots.runtime.feishuConnectionRecoverySug.en: The long-connection limit may have been reached, or Feishu may be busy. Try again later; if the problem persists, bind a new bot.
bots.runtime.feishuConnectionRecoverySug.zh: 长连接数可能已达上限或飞书服务繁忙。请稍后重试；若持续失败，可绑定新的机器人。

bots.runtime.larkConnectionRecoverySugge.en: The long-connection limit may have been reached, or Lark may be busy. Try again later; if the problem persists, bind a new bot.
bots.runtime.larkConnectionRecoverySugge.zh: 长连接数可能已达上限或 Lark 服务繁忙。请稍后重试；若持续失败，可绑定新的机器人。

bots.allowedWorkspaces.allDescription.en: This bot can use any configured workspace.
bots.allowedWorkspaces.allDescription.zh: 这个机器人可以使用所有已配置的工作区。

bots.allowedWorkspaces.selectedDescripti.en: This bot can use {count} selected workspaces.
bots.allowedWorkspaces.selectedDescripti.zh: 这个机器人可以使用 {count} 个指定工作区。

bots.botMeta.zh: {users} 个已绑定用户 · 工作区 {workspace}

bots.editDescription.en: Review runtime state, default context, reply detail, and bound users.
bots.editDescription.zh: 查看运行状态，调整默认上下文、回复颗粒度和绑定用户。

bots.edit.emptyUsers.en: No users bound yet. Create a bind code, then send the bind command in the bot private chat.
bots.edit.emptyUsers.zh: 还没有绑定用户。生成绑定码后，在机器人私聊里发送绑定命令。

bots.deleteConfirmDescription.en: This removes the bot configuration, credentials, and binding state. This cannot be undone.
bots.deleteConfirmDescription.zh: 删除后会移除这个机器人的配置、凭据和绑定状态，无法撤销。

bots.bindHint.en: Send {command} in a private bot chat.

bots.bindCodeExpires.zh: 绑定码将在 {time} 后失效

bots.bindCodeExpired.en: Bind code expired. Generate a new code.
bots.bindCodeExpired.zh: 绑定码已过期，请重新生成。

bots.bindCommandGuide.en: Copy the bind command below, then send it to the bot in a private chat.
bots.bindCommandGuide.zh: 复制下面的绑定命令，并发送给机器人私聊。

bots.bindCommandStep.openChat.en: Open the private chat with the bot

bots.bindCommandStep.send.en: Paste and send it to bind the current workspace
bots.bindCommandStep.send.zh: 粘贴并发送，完成当前工作区绑定

bots.bindCommandCopied.en: Bind command copied. Open the private bot chat, then paste and send it.
bots.bindCommandCopied.zh: 绑定命令已复制，请打开机器人私聊，粘贴并发送。

settings.computerUse.disabledToast.en: Computer Use is disabled. Existing conversations require a ZCode restart to take effect.
settings.computerUse.disabledToast.zh: 电脑控制已关闭，已有对话需重启 ZCode 后生效。

settings.modelProvider.connectionSuggest.en: Plan availability has changed. Please select a connection in model settings.
settings.modelProvider.connectionSuggest.zh: 套餐状态已变化，请在模型设置中重新选择。

settings.modelProvider.connectionSwitchF.en: Could not switch plans. The original connection is unchanged. Please retry.
settings.modelProvider.connectionSwitchF.zh: 切换套餐失败，原连接未更改。请重试。

settings.modelProvider.connectionUnavail.en: The selected connection is unavailable. Please choose another connection.
settings.modelProvider.connectionUnavail.zh: 原连接方式已不可用，请重新选择。

settings.modelProvider.navigationUnavail.en: The requested provider is unavailable. Please choose another provider.
settings.modelProvider.navigationUnavail.zh: 要查看的供应商不可用，请选择其他供应商。

settings.onboardingDescription.en: Choose your role, interface mode, and preferences again. Use Migration settings to import data.
settings.onboardingDescription.zh: 重新选择职业、界面模式和使用偏好。数据迁移可在迁移设置中操作。

settings.subagents.modelLoadFailed.en: The model list failed to load.

settings.subtitle.en: Switch major settings on the left and edit the details in the panel on the right.
settings.subtitle.zh: 从左侧切换主要设置项，右侧查看详细配置。

settings.nav.appearanceDescription.en: Theme, UI font size, and code presentation
settings.nav.appearanceDescription.zh: 主题、界面字号与代码显示

settings.themeCardDescription.en: Use light, dark, or follow the system setting
settings.themeCardDescription.zh: 使用浅色、深色，或匹配系统设置

settings.interfaceMode.description.en: Office mode focuses on summaries and results. Coding mode shows commands, output, and code changes.
settings.interfaceMode.description.zh: 办公模式侧重操作摘要与结果；编程模式显示命令、输出和代码变更详情。

settings.themeModeDescription.en: Choose light, dark, or follow the system theme.
settings.themeModeDescription.zh: 选择浅色、深色或跟随系统主题。

settings.shortcuts.keySearchPlaceholder.en: Press a key combination to search…

settings.shortcuts.resetAllConfirmDescri.en: This clears all custom keybinding overrides and restores every command to its default binding.
settings.shortcuts.resetAllConfirmDescri.zh: 将清除所有自定义键位覆盖，全部命令回到默认绑定。

settings.shortcuts.recordingHint.en: Esc to cancel · Backspace to reset · press a new combo after a conflict
settings.shortcuts.recordingHint.zh: Esc 取消 · Backspace 恢复默认 · 冲突后直接重按新组合

settings.shortcuts.conflictReserved.en: This combination is reserved by the system
settings.shortcuts.conflictReserved.zh: 该组合为系统保留键位

settings.shortcuts.clearConflict.en: The default key is already used by "{command}"; restoring it would create a conflict. Adjust that command first
settings.shortcuts.clearConflict.zh: 默认键已被「{command}」占用，恢复默认会造成同键冲突，请先调整该命令

settings.shortcuts.stealConfirm.zh: 仍要绑定（原命令将失效）

settings.shortcuts.invalidNoModifier.en: At least one modifier key is required (Ctrl / Cmd / Alt)
settings.shortcuts.invalidNoModifier.zh: 至少需要一个修饰键（Ctrl / Cmd / Alt）

settings.shortcuts.duplicateBinding.zh: 该组合已绑定到此命令

settings.appearance.interfaceDescription.en: Choose the app theme and interface text size.
settings.appearance.interfaceDescription.zh: 设置应用主题和界面文字大小。

settings.appearance.codeDescription.en: Choose code themes, font size, and display options independently from the interface font size.
settings.appearance.codeDescription.zh: 设置代码内容的主题、字号和显示方式，不受界面字号影响。

settings.uiFontSizeDescription.en: Adjust interface text without changing icons or layout dimensions.
settings.uiFontSizeDescription.zh: 调整应用界面的文字大小，图标和布局尺寸不受影响。

settings.systemDescription.en: These preferences affect the current window experience.
settings.systemDescription.zh: 这些设置会影响当前窗口的显示与交互。

settings.localeDescription.en: Choose the display language used by the application UI.
settings.localeDescription.zh: 选择应用 UI 的显示语言。

settings.terminalProfileDescription.en: When launching the built-in terminal, inherit login shell environment, proxy, Kubernetes variables, and local terminal font when possible.
settings.terminalProfileDescription.zh: 启动内置终端时尽量继承登录 shell 环境、代理、Kube 变量和本机终端字体。

settings.terminalFontFamilyDescription.en: Leave blank to auto-detect system terminal settings; set a value to override the ZCode terminal font.
settings.terminalFontFamilyDescription.zh: 留空时自动探测系统终端配置；填写后作为 ZCode 终端的字体覆盖。

settings.terminalFontFamilyPlaceholder.en: Leave blank to inherit, e.g. MesloLGS NF, monospace
settings.terminalFontFamilyPlaceholder.zh: 留空自动继承，例如 MesloLGS NF, monospace

settings.integratedTerminalShellDescript.en: Applies to new sessions only. On Windows, Bash uses this shell; Auto tries Git Bash, then cmd.exe.
settings.integratedTerminalShellDescript.zh: 仅新会话生效。Windows 下 Bash 工具用此 shell；自动优先 Git Bash，找不到回退 cmd.exe。

settings.nativeSearchEnhancementsDescrip.en: Use enhanced Find and Grep in new sessions and sessions restored after an app restart. Active sessions keep their current setting; Find remains unchanged on Windows.
settings.nativeSearchEnhancementsDescrip.zh: 在新建会话或应用重启后恢复的会话中使用增强 Find 和 Grep。当前会话保持现有设置；Windows 的 Find 保持不变。

settings.memoryDescription.en: Save and reuse long-term context in workspaces. Applies to new sessions and may increase model requests and token costs.
settings.memoryDescription.zh: 在工作区中保存并复用长期上下文，新会话生效。开启后可能增加模型调用和 Token 成本。

settings.memory.viewer.localOnly.en: Memory details are available only in the local desktop app. Open Memory settings there to view them.
settings.memory.viewer.localOnly.zh: 记忆详情仅支持在本地桌面端查看，请前往本地桌面端的“记忆”设置。

settings.memory.viewer.description.en: Browse memories saved by workspace on this device.
settings.memory.viewer.description.zh: 查看此设备上按工作区保存的记忆。

settings.memory.viewer.projectsDescripti.en: Select a project to view all of its saved memories.
settings.memory.viewer.projectsDescripti.zh: 选择一个项目，查看该项目保存的全部记忆。

settings.memory.viewer.empty.zh: 暂无已保存的工作区记忆

settings.memory.viewer.fileDeleted.en: This memory file has been deleted. Refresh the file list to update it.
settings.memory.viewer.fileDeleted.zh: 该记忆文件已被删除，请刷新文件列表。

settings.memory.viewer.fileTooLarge.en: This memory file exceeds the 5 MiB preview limit.
settings.memory.viewer.fileTooLarge.zh: 该记忆文件超过 5 MiB 预览上限。

settings.memory.viewer.fileChanged.en: This memory file was updated while being read. Reopen it or refresh the file list.
settings.memory.viewer.fileChanged.zh: 该记忆文件在读取期间已更新，请重新打开或刷新文件列表。

settings.memory.viewer.noSelection.en: Select a memory file to preview it.
settings.memory.viewer.noSelection.zh: 选择一个记忆文件以查看内容。

settings.httpProxyDescription.en: Route model, MCP, command-tool, and app renderer egress traffic through this proxy; system environment variables are not read. Leave blank and that traffic connects directly, while the embedded browser follows your system proxy settings. Restart the app to take effect.
settings.httpProxyDescription.zh: 模型、MCP、命令工具与应用渲染层的出口流量将经此代理，不读取系统环境变量。留空时这些流量直连，内置浏览器则跟随系统代理设置。修改后需重启应用生效。

settings.httpProxyPlaceholder.en: Blank means the embedded browser follows the system proxy, e.g. http://127.0.0.1:7890
settings.httpProxyPlaceholder.zh: 留空则内置浏览器跟随系统代理，例如 http://127.0.0.1:7890

settings.httpProxyNoProxyDescription.en: Requests matching these hosts connect directly instead of using the HTTP proxy. Separate rules with commas. Restart the app to take effect.
settings.httpProxyNoProxyDescription.zh: 匹配这些主机的请求将直连，不经过 HTTP 代理。多个规则用英文逗号分隔。修改后需重启应用生效。

settings.httpProxyCaCertPathDescription.en: Optional. Set a PEM root certificate path to inject it as NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS for models, MCP, and command tools, and to trust it in renderer certificate verification. Restart the app to take effect.
settings.httpProxyCaCertPathDescription.zh: 可选。填写 PEM 根证书路径后，会作为 NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS 注入模型、MCP 与命令工具，并用于渲染层证书校验。修改后需重启应用生效。

settings.httpProxySavedHint.en: Network proxy settings saved. Restart the app to take effect.
settings.httpProxySavedHint.zh: 网络代理设置已保存，重启应用后生效

settings.desktopChromiumHardwareAccelera.en: Turn this off to work around blank windows, crashes, or rendering issues caused by some GPUs or drivers. Restart the app to take effect.
settings.desktopChromiumHardwareAccelera.zh: 关闭后可规避部分显卡或驱动导致的白屏、闪退、渲染异常。修改后需重启应用生效。

settings.desktopChromiumHardwareAccelera.en: Chrome hardware acceleration setting saved. Restart the app to take effect.
settings.desktopChromiumHardwareAccelera.zh: Chrome 硬件加速设置已保存，重启应用后生效

settings.receivePreviewUpdates.zh: 接受提前收到预览版更新

settings.receivePreviewUpdatesDescriptio.en: When enabled, you will get the earliest access to new features and improvements. When disabled, you will receive update pushes according to the regular release schedule.
settings.receivePreviewUpdatesDescriptio.zh: 开启后将最快、提前体验新功能和改进版本，关闭后将随着版本发布节奏获得版本推送更新。

settings.autoDownloadAndInstallUpdatesDe.en: When enabled, updates start downloading as soon as they are found. Restart still requires confirmation when tasks are running.
settings.autoDownloadAndInstallUpdatesDe.zh: 开启后检测到更新会自动开始下载；下载完成后，如有任务正在运行，重启更新前仍会要求确认。

settings.notificationDescription.en: Send desktop notifications when a task completes, fails, or needs approval.
settings.notificationDescription.zh: 任务完成、失败或需要确认时发送桌面通知。

settings.notificationSoundDescription.en: When notifications are enabled, you can mute the task notification sound separately.
settings.notificationSoundDescription.zh: 通知开启后，可单独关闭任务通知提示音。

settings.closeToTrayOnWindows.en: Hide to tray when closing window
settings.closeToTrayOnWindows.zh: 关闭窗口时隐藏到托盘

settings.closeToTrayOnWindowsDescription.en: Windows only. The close button and close-window shortcut hide the window, while Quit from the tray still exits the app.
settings.closeToTrayOnWindowsDescription.zh: 仅 Windows 生效。点击关闭按钮或关闭窗口快捷键时隐藏窗口，托盘中的退出仍会完全退出应用。

settings.keepAwakeWhileRunningDescriptio.en: Prevent the system from sleeping due to idle. You can still sleep manually or by closing the lid. Desktop only.
settings.keepAwakeWhileRunningDescriptio.zh: 打开后阻止系统因空闲进入休眠（仍可手动睡眠/合盖休眠）。桌面端全局生效。

settings.messageStreamShowReasoningDescr.en: Show full reasoning inside the message stream. When off, the first reasoning item in each turn remains visible.
settings.messageStreamShowReasoningDescr.zh: 在消息流中展示完整的模型思考内容；关闭时每轮仍展示第一次思考。

settings.messageStreamShowTodosDescripti.en: Show Todo tool cards inside the message stream.
settings.messageStreamShowTodosDescripti.zh: 在消息流中展示 Todo 工具卡片。

settings.toolGroupingExploreDescription.en: Group consecutive reads and searches into an Explore section.
settings.toolGroupingExploreDescription.zh: 将连续的读取和搜索工具聚合为 Explore 分组。

settings.toolGroupingTerminalDescription.en: Group consecutive non-read-only shell commands into a Terminal section.
settings.toolGroupingTerminalDescription.zh: 将连续的非只读 Shell 命令聚合为 Terminal 分组。

settings.toolGroupingChangesDescription.en: Group consecutive Write, Edit, and ApplyPatch calls into a Changes section.
settings.toolGroupingChangesDescription.zh: 将连续的 Write、Edit 和 ApplyPatch 调用聚合为 Changes 分组。

settings.zcodeInteractionBehaviorDescrip.en: While ZCode is running, add follow-up actions to the queue or guide them to run after the next tool call.
settings.zcodeInteractionBehaviorDescrip.zh: 在 ZCode 运行时将后续操作加入队列，或引导至下一轮工具调用后运行。

settings.askUserQuestionAutoResolutionDe.en: When enabled, Agent questions automatically continue after 5 minutes without an answer. When disabled, current and future questions wait for your response.
settings.askUserQuestionAutoResolutionDe.zh: 开启后，Agent 提问 5 分钟未回答会自动继续；关闭后，当前和后续提问会一直等待你的回答。

settings.modelIoFullRetentionDescription.en: Keep complete model requests and responses without compression, size limits, or automatic deletion.
settings.modelIoFullRetentionDescription.zh: 保留完整的模型请求和响应，不自动压缩、限制大小或删除旧记录。

settings.performanceModeDescription.en: Simplify rendered output to improve performance.
settings.performanceModeDescription.zh: 精简渲染输出，提高性能。

settings.taskAutoArchiveDescription.en: Periodically scan recently opened workspaces and automatically archive completed, unread-free, unpinned tasks after the retention window.
settings.taskAutoArchiveDescription.zh: 定时扫描最近打开过的工作区，将已完成、无未读、未置顶且超过保留期的任务自动归档。

settings.taskAutoArchiveDaysDescription.en: A task becomes eligible for auto-archive only after its last update is older than this window.
settings.taskAutoArchiveDaysDescription.zh: 任务最后更新时间早于该时长后，才会进入自动归档候选。

settings.dataBaseDirDescription.en: Root directory for app data (defaults to user home directory). Existing data will be copied to the new location. The .zcode/v2 suffix cannot be changed.
settings.dataBaseDirDescription.zh: 应用数据的根目录（默认为用户主目录），修改后会将现有数据复制到新位置。路径后缀 .zcode/v2 不可更改。

settings.dataBaseDirCopying.en: Copying data, please do not close the app...
settings.dataBaseDirCopying.zh: 正在复制数据，请勿关闭应用…

settings.dataBaseDirCopyFailed.en: Data copy failed. Path was not changed.
settings.dataBaseDirCopyFailed.zh: 数据复制失败，路径未更改。

settings.dataBaseDirForbiddenInstallDir.en: The data directory cannot be the ZCode installation folder on Windows. Choose a folder outside the app install location.
settings.dataBaseDirForbiddenInstallDir.zh: 不能选择 ZCode 安装目录作为数据存储路径。请选择安装目录之外的文件夹。

settings.dataBaseDirRestartRequired.en: Data saved. Please restart the app to take effect.
settings.dataBaseDirRestartRequired.zh: 数据已保存，重启应用后生效。

settings.migration.sectionDescription.en: Scan native Claude Code history on this machine, optionally filter by workspace and activity window, then import the selected sessions into their matching ZCode task lists.
settings.migration.sectionDescription.zh: 扫描本机 Claude Code 原生历史，可按 workspace 和时间范围筛选，再把选中的会话导入到对应的 ZCode 任务列表。

settings.migration.currentWorkspaceDescr.en: This is only an optional filter. If you do not choose the current workspace, the scan covers all Claude records.
settings.migration.currentWorkspaceDescr.zh: 这里只作为可选筛选条件使用；不选择当前 workspace 时，会扫描全部 Claude 记录。

settings.migration.workspaceEmpty.en: No active workspace on this page. You can still scan all records.
settings.migration.workspaceEmpty.zh: 当前页面没有可用工作区，可直接扫描全部记录

settings.migration.noticeDescription.en: Migration copies the native jsonl files and generates minimal task snapshots. Without a workspace filter, the scan covers all Claude records and imports each session back into its own source workspace.
settings.migration.noticeDescription.zh: 迁移会复制原生 jsonl 并生成最小 task 快照；未设置 workspace 筛选时，会从全部 Claude 记录中扫描，并按每条记录自己的 workspace 归属导入。

settings.migration.unsupported.title.zh: 当前环境暂不支持迁移

settings.migration.unsupported.desktopOn.en: Migration is currently available on desktop only.
settings.migration.unsupported.desktopOn.zh: 迁移能力当前只支持桌面端。

settings.migration.filtersDescription.en: Filter by workspace, recent activity, and result size, then manually fetch the candidate sessions.
settings.migration.filtersDescription.zh: 可按 workspace、最近活跃时间和返回数量筛选，然后手动触发一次候选会话扫描。

settings.migration.limitHint.en: This scan will return up to {max} sessions.
settings.migration.limitHint.zh: 本次扫描最多返回 {max} 条结果。

settings.migration.scanFailedDescription.en: Failed to read Claude native history: {error}
settings.migration.scanFailedDescription.zh: 读取 Claude 原生历史失败：{error}

settings.migration.candidatesDescription.en: Select one or more sessions to import. Each imported session is written back into the task list for its own workspace.
settings.migration.candidatesDescription.zh: 选择一个或多个会话后执行导入；每条记录会写入它自己的目标 workspace 任务列表。

settings.migration.resultSummary.zh: 成功导入 {imported} 条，跳过 {skipped} 条，失败 {failed} 条。

settings.migration.emptyDescription.en: Adjust the filters, then click 'Scan sessions' to load matching results.
settings.migration.emptyDescription.zh: 调整筛选条件后点击“扫描候选会话”，结果会显示在这里。

settings.migration.reason.session_not_fo.en: The source session was not found, or it no longer matches the current workspace filter.
settings.migration.reason.session_not_fo.zh: 源会话不存在，或已经不匹配当前 workspace 筛选。

settings.usageDescription.en: Review rough activity and model usage aggregated from local sessions.
settings.usageDescription.zh: 查看会话活跃度与模型用量的粗略统计。

settings.browser.control.description.en: Enable the official Browser Use plugin so new sessions can access and control web pages in the built-in browser.
settings.browser.control.description.zh: 启用 Browser Use 官方插件，让新会话可以通过内置浏览器访问和操作网页。

settings.browser.control.enabledToast.zh: 已开启内置浏览器控制

settings.browser.control.disabledToast.zh: 已关闭内置浏览器控制

settings.embeddedBrowserAllowInsecureCer.en: When enabled, the built-in browser stops verifying HTTPS certificates. Affects the built-in browser only. Restart to take effect.
settings.embeddedBrowserAllowInsecureCer.zh: 开启后内置浏览器不再校验 HTTPS 证书，仅影响内置浏览器。修改后需重启生效。

settings.embeddedBrowserAllowInsecureCer.en: Certificate setting saved. Restart the app to take effect.
settings.embeddedBrowserAllowInsecureCer.zh: 证书校验设置已保存，重启应用后生效

settings.browser.desktopOnly.en: Browser data can only be managed in the ZCode desktop app.
settings.browser.desktopOnly.zh: 浏览器数据只能在 ZCode 桌面端管理。

settings.browser.import.title.zh: 导入 Chrome 登录状态

settings.browser.import.description.en: Bring your Chrome sign-in state into the built-in browser once, so the AI can open sites you are already signed in to and work more smoothly.
settings.browser.import.description.zh: 一次性把 Chrome 登录状态带到内置浏览器，AI 就能直接打开你已经登录的网站，操作更流畅。

settings.browser.import.notFound.en: No importable Chrome profile was found. Open Chrome and make sure the profile contains browsing data.
settings.browser.import.notFound.zh: 未找到可导入的 Chrome Profile。请先打开 Chrome 并确认已有浏览数据。

settings.browser.import.ambiguous.en: Multiple Chrome profiles were found, but the most recently used profile could not be determined. Open the profile you want to import and try again.
settings.browser.import.ambiguous.zh: 发现多个 Chrome Profile，但无法确定最近使用的 Profile。请先打开要导入的 Profile 后重试。

settings.browser.import.executableNotFou.en: Chrome was not found. Install Chrome and try again.
settings.browser.import.executableNotFou.zh: Chrome 未找到。请安装 Chrome 后重试。

settings.browser.import.accessDenied.en: Import canceled: access to Chrome Safe Storage in the macOS Keychain was not allowed. No Chrome data was imported.
settings.browser.import.accessDenied.zh: 已取消导入：你未允许访问 macOS 钥匙串中的 Chrome 安全存储，未导入任何 Chrome 数据。

settings.browser.import.elevationRequire.en: Confirm administrator access before importing Chrome cookies protected by App-Bound encryption.
settings.browser.import.elevationRequire.zh: 需要确认管理员授权后才能导入受 App-Bound 保护的 Chrome Cookie。

settings.browser.import.elevationCancell.en: Windows administrator access was canceled. No cookies were imported.
settings.browser.import.elevationCancell.zh: 已取消 Windows 管理员授权，Cookie 未导入。

settings.browser.import.helperVerificati.en: ZCode could not verify its Windows secure import component. Reinstall or update ZCode before importing cookies.
settings.browser.import.helperVerificati.zh: ZCode 的 Windows 安全导入组件校验失败，Cookie 未导入。请重新安装或更新 ZCode。

conversationShare.permission.linkEditorS.en: Link holders can import and continue

conversationShare.publishSucceededWithSk.en: Share link created; {count} file(s) were skipped
conversationShare.publishSucceededWithSk.zh: 分享链接已生成，有 {count} 个文件被跳过

conversationShare.publishFailed.en: Could not generate the share link. Try again.
conversationShare.publishFailed.zh: 生成分享链接失败，请重试

conversationShare.error.authenticationRe.en: Sharing is available only when you are signed in. Your sign-in has expired; sign in again, then retry.

conversationShare.error.featureDisabled.en: Sharing is not available for this workspace or connection type.
conversationShare.error.featureDisabled.zh: 当前工作区或连接类型暂不支持分享。

conversationShare.error.artifactNotAllow.en: A previewed file type is not supported for sharing. Deselect that conversation and retry.
conversationShare.error.artifactNotAllow.zh: 某个预览文件的类型暂不支持分享，请取消选择对应对话后重试。

conversationShare.error.limitExceeded.en: The selected conversation or its files exceed the sharing limit. Select fewer conversations.
conversationShare.error.limitExceeded.zh: 所选对话或文件超过分享限制，请减少选择的对话数量。

conversationShare.error.rateLimited.en: Too many share attempts. Wait a moment, then try again.
conversationShare.error.rateLimited.zh: 分享操作过于频繁，请稍后再试。

conversationShare.error.network.en: Could not reach the sharing service. Check your connection and try again.
conversationShare.error.network.zh: 无法连接分享服务，请检查网络后重试。

conversationShare.error.safetyCheckTimeo.en: The share safety check took too long. Try again later.
conversationShare.error.safetyCheckTimeo.zh: 分享安全检查超时，请稍后重试。

conversationShare.error.invalidSelection.en: The selected conversation changed. Reopen the share panel and select it again.
conversationShare.error.invalidSelection.zh: 所选对话已发生变化，请重新打开分享面板并选择。

conversationShare.error.invalidConversat.en: The selection contains a structure that is not shareable yet. Deselect active turns or inline images, confirm preview files are complete, and retry.
conversationShare.error.invalidConversat.zh: 所选内容包含当前版本暂不支持的结构。请取消仍在运行或包含内嵌图片的轮次，确认预览文件已完成后重试。

conversationShare.error.runningTurn.en: A selected turn is still running. Deselect it and wait for it to finish before sharing.
conversationShare.error.runningTurn.zh: 所选对话仍在运行，请取消选择运行中的轮次，等待完成后再分享。

conversationShare.error.streamingRow.en: A selected response is still streaming. Wait for the turn to finish before sharing.
conversationShare.error.streamingRow.zh: 所选对话仍在生成中，请等待本轮输出完成后再分享。

conversationShare.error.activeToolCall.en: A selected tool call is still active. Wait for it to finish before sharing.
conversationShare.error.activeToolCall.zh: 所选对话仍有工具调用未完成，请等待工具结束后再分享。

conversationShare.error.activeSubagent.en: A selected subtask is still running. Wait for it to finish before sharing.
conversationShare.error.activeSubagent.zh: 所选对话包含仍在运行的子任务，请等待子任务结束后再分享。

conversationShare.error.inputAttachment.en: A user-input attachment could not be shared. Check that it still exists and try again.
conversationShare.error.inputAttachment.zh: 用户输入附件当前无法完成分享，请确认附件仍存在后重试。

conversationShare.error.inlineToolImage.en: A selected turn contains an unsupported inline tool image. Deselect that turn and retry.
conversationShare.error.inlineToolImage.zh: 所选对话包含暂不支持的内嵌工具图片，请取消对应轮次后重试。

conversationShare.error.unsupportedTimel.en: A selected turn contains an unsupported branch or restore record. Deselect that turn and retry.
conversationShare.error.unsupportedTimel.zh: 所选对话包含暂不支持的分支或恢复记录，请取消对应轮次后重试。

conversationShare.error.unsafeUrl.en: The selected content contains a local or inline file URL. Remove it before sharing.
conversationShare.error.unsafeUrl.zh: 所选内容包含本地或内联文件地址，请移除后再分享。

conversationShare.error.missingProductTu.en: The selected conversation is incomplete. Reopen the share panel and select the turn again.
conversationShare.error.missingProductTu.zh: 所选对话结构不完整，请重新打开分享面板并重新选择轮次。

conversationShare.error.artifactTypeNotA.en: A previewed file type is not allowed for sharing. Deselect its turn and retry.
conversationShare.error.artifactTypeNotA.zh: 某个预览文件类型暂不支持分享，请取消对应轮次后重试。

conversationShare.error.artifactExtensio.en: A previewed file has no valid extension. Check the file and retry.
conversationShare.error.artifactExtensio.zh: 某个预览文件缺少有效扩展名，请检查文件后重试。

conversationShare.error.artifactOutsideW.en: A previewed file is outside the current workspace. Regenerate or move it, then retry.
conversationShare.error.artifactOutsideW.zh: 某个预览文件不在当前工作区内，请重新生成或移动文件后重试。

conversationShare.error.artifactChanged.en: A previewed file changed before sharing. Regenerate the preview file and retry.
conversationShare.error.artifactChanged.zh: 某个预览文件在分享前发生变化，请重新生成预览文件后重试。

conversationShare.error.artifactReadFail.en: A previewed file could not be read. Check that it still exists and is accessible, then retry.
conversationShare.error.artifactReadFail.zh: 某个预览文件读取失败，请确认文件仍存在且可访问后重试。

conversationShare.error.artifactSizeLimi.en: A file exceeds the per-file size limit. Deselect that turn or use a smaller file, then retry.
conversationShare.error.artifactSizeLimi.zh: 某个文件超过单文件大小上限，请取消该轮或改用更小的文件后重试。

conversationShare.error.artifactManifest.en: The preview file manifest is incomplete. Regenerate the file and refresh the share panel.
conversationShare.error.artifactManifest.zh: 预览文件清单不完整，请重新生成文件并刷新分享面板后重试。

conversationShare.error.payloadLimit.en: The selected conversation or files exceed the sharing limit. Select less and retry.
conversationShare.error.payloadLimit.zh: 所选对话或文件超过分享限制，请减少选择后重试。

conversationShare.error.disclosureRequir.en: Review and confirm the shared content before creating the link.
conversationShare.error.disclosureRequir.zh: 请先检查并确认分享内容，再生成链接。

conversationShare.error.uploadFailed.en: A file could not be uploaded completely. Check that it still exists, then retry.
conversationShare.error.uploadFailed.zh: 文件未能完整上传，请确认文件仍然存在后重试。

conversationShare.error.connectionUnavai.en: Desktop connection is not ready. Reopen the share panel and try again.
conversationShare.error.connectionUnavai.zh: 桌面连接尚未就绪，请重新打开分享面板后重试。

conversationShare.error.noShareableConte.en: The current selection has no shareable content. Select different turns.
conversationShare.error.noShareableConte.zh: 当前选择没有可分享内容，请重新选择需要分享的轮次。

conversationShare.error.summary.en: Share failed: {count} issue(s) found. See the share panel for details.
conversationShare.error.summary.zh: 分享失败：发现 {count} 个问题，详情见分享面板。

conversationShare.issue.artifactTypeNotA.en: Turn {turnOrdinal}: {artifactDisplayName} ({artifactType}) cannot be shared and will be skipped. Supported types: {allowedFormats}.
conversationShare.issue.artifactTypeNotA.zh: 第 {turnOrdinal} 轮的 {artifactDisplayName}（{artifactType}）暂不支持分享，将被跳过。当前支持：{allowedFormats}。

conversationShare.issue.artifactExtensio.en: Turn {turnOrdinal}: the preview file has no valid extension. Check the file name and try again.
conversationShare.issue.artifactExtensio.zh: 第 {turnOrdinal} 轮的预览文件缺少有效扩展名，请检查文件名后重试。

conversationShare.issue.artifactOutsideW.en: Turn {turnOrdinal}: the preview file is outside the current workspace. Move or regenerate it and try again.
conversationShare.issue.artifactOutsideW.zh: 第 {turnOrdinal} 轮的预览文件不在当前工作区内，请重新生成或移动文件后重试。

conversationShare.issue.artifactChanged.en: Turn {turnOrdinal}: {artifactDisplayName} changed while it was being read. Regenerate the file and try again.
conversationShare.issue.artifactChanged.zh: 第 {turnOrdinal} 轮的 {artifactDisplayName} 在读取期间发生变化，请重新生成文件后重试。

conversationShare.issue.artifactReadFail.en: Turn {turnOrdinal}: {artifactDisplayName} could not be read. Check that it still exists and is accessible.
conversationShare.issue.artifactReadFail.zh: 第 {turnOrdinal} 轮的 {artifactDisplayName} 无法读取，请确认文件仍存在且可访问。

conversationShare.issue.inputAttachment.en: Turn {turnOrdinal} contains a user-input attachment, which is not supported in this version. Deselect this turn.
conversationShare.issue.inputAttachment.zh: 第 {turnOrdinal} 轮包含用户输入附件，当前版本不支持，请取消该轮。

conversationShare.issue.inputAttachmentU.en: Turn {turnOrdinal} contains a user-input attachment that no longer exists or cannot be read.
conversationShare.issue.inputAttachmentU.zh: 第 {turnOrdinal} 轮的用户输入附件已不存在或无法读取。

conversationShare.issue.inlineToolImage.en: Turn {turnOrdinal} contains an inline tool image that cannot be included in a public share.
conversationShare.issue.inlineToolImage.zh: 第 {turnOrdinal} 轮包含无法公开承载的内嵌工具图片。

conversationShare.issue.runningTurn.en: Turn {turnOrdinal} is still running. Wait for it to finish or deselect it.
conversationShare.issue.runningTurn.zh: 第 {turnOrdinal} 轮仍在运行，请等待完成或取消该轮。

conversationShare.issue.streamingRow.en: Turn {turnOrdinal} is still generating. Wait for it to finish or deselect it.
conversationShare.issue.streamingRow.zh: 第 {turnOrdinal} 轮仍在生成，请等待完成或取消该轮。

conversationShare.issue.activeToolCall.en: Turn {turnOrdinal} has an unfinished tool call. Deselect this turn.
conversationShare.issue.activeToolCall.zh: 第 {turnOrdinal} 轮仍有工具调用未完成，请取消该轮。

conversationShare.issue.activeSubagent.en: Turn {turnOrdinal} has a running subtask. Wait for it to finish or deselect it.
conversationShare.issue.activeSubagent.zh: 第 {turnOrdinal} 轮仍有子任务运行，请等待完成或取消该轮。

conversationShare.issue.unsupportedTimel.en: Turn {turnOrdinal} contains a timeline record that cannot be included in a public share.
conversationShare.issue.unsupportedTimel.zh: 第 {turnOrdinal} 轮包含当前无法公开承载的时间线记录。

conversationShare.issue.noShareableConte.en: The current selection has no shareable content. Select different turns.
conversationShare.issue.noShareableConte.zh: 当前选择没有可分享内容，请重新选择需要分享的轮次。

conversationShare.issue.unsafeUrl.en: Turn {turnOrdinal} contains a local or inline file address, which is not supported. Remove it and try again.
conversationShare.issue.unsafeUrl.zh: 第 {turnOrdinal} 轮包含本地或内联文件地址，当前版本不支持，请移除后重试。

conversationShare.issue.missingProductTu.en: The selection is missing a complete turn identity. Re-select the conversation.
conversationShare.issue.missingProductTu.zh: 所选内容缺少完整轮次身份，请重新选择对话。

conversationShare.issue.invalidSelection.en: The selected turns changed. Return to selection and choose them again.
conversationShare.issue.invalidSelection.zh: 所选轮次已发生变化，请返回选择并重新勾选。

conversationShare.issue.invalidConversat.en: The selected conversation is incomplete. Deselect the affected turn(s) and try again.
conversationShare.issue.invalidConversat.zh: 所选对话结构不完整，请取消问题轮次后重试。

conversationShare.issue.staleConversatio.en: The conversation changed while the share was prepared. Return to selection and try again.
conversationShare.issue.staleConversatio.zh: 会话在准备分享期间发生变化，请返回选择后重试。

conversationShare.issue.rowsLimit.en: The conversation has {actual} rows, above the limit of {limit}. Reduce the selected turns.
conversationShare.issue.rowsLimit.zh: 对话行数为 {actual}，超过上限 {limit}，请减少选择的轮次。

conversationShare.issue.artifactCountLim.en: The conversation has {actual} artifacts, above the limit of {limit}. Reduce the selected turns.
conversationShare.issue.artifactCountLim.zh: 产物数量为 {actual}，超过上限 {limit}，请减少选择的轮次。

conversationShare.issue.artifactSizeLimi.en: {artifactDisplayName} is {actual}, above the per-file limit of {limit}. Deselect the turn or regenerate a smaller file.
conversationShare.issue.artifactSizeLimi.zh: {artifactDisplayName} 大小为 {actual}，超过单文件上限 {limit}，请取消该轮或重新生成较小文件。

conversationShare.issue.artifactTotalSiz.en: Artifacts total {actual}, above the limit of {limit}. Reduce artifacts or deselect the affected turn(s).
conversationShare.issue.artifactTotalSiz.zh: 产物总大小为 {actual}，超过上限 {limit}，请减少产物或取消对应轮次。

conversationShare.issue.payloadSizeLimit.en: The share request is {actual}, above the limit of {limit}. Reduce the selected turns or artifacts.
conversationShare.issue.payloadSizeLimit.zh: 分享请求大小为 {actual}，超过上限 {limit}，请减少选择的轮次或产物。

conversationShare.issue.artifactManifest.en: The preview artifact manifest is duplicated or incomplete. Regenerate files and refresh the share panel.
conversationShare.issue.artifactManifest.zh: 预览文件清单存在重复或缺失，请重新生成文件并刷新分享面板。

conversationShare.issue.uploadIncomplete.en: The upload acknowledgement for {artifactDisplayName} does not match the file. Ensure it did not change and try again.
conversationShare.issue.uploadIncomplete.zh: {artifactDisplayName} 上传回执与文件不一致，请确认文件未变化后重试。

conversationShare.issue.unknown.en: Share failed during {phase}; the server returned no actionable details. Try again later.
conversationShare.issue.unknown.zh: 分享在 {phase} 阶段失败，服务端未返回可定位详情，请稍后重试。

conversationShare.issue.requestIdMissing.en: No server request ID was received.

conversationShare.issue.more.zh: 还有 {count} 个问题未展开。

conversationShare.warning.summary.en: Shared successfully. {count} file(s) were skipped and are not included in the link.
conversationShare.warning.summary.zh: 分享已完成，有 {count} 个文件被跳过，未包含在链接中。

conversationShare.warning.artifactSkippe.en: Turn {turnOrdinal}: {artifactDisplayName} could not be read, so it was skipped. If it should have been shared, regenerate the file and share again.
conversationShare.warning.artifactSkippe.zh: 第 {turnOrdinal} 轮的 {artifactDisplayName} 无法读取，已跳过。如果确实需要分享该文件，请重新生成后再分享。

conversationShare.warning.inputAttachmen.en: Turn {turnOrdinal}: the input attachment is not included in the share; the turn's text is still shared.
conversationShare.warning.inputAttachmen.zh: 第 {turnOrdinal} 轮的用户输入附件未包含在分享中，该轮文字内容照常分享。

conversationShare.warning.inputAttachmen.en: Turn {turnOrdinal}: {artifactDisplayName} no longer exists or cannot be read and was skipped.
conversationShare.warning.inputAttachmen.zh: 第 {turnOrdinal} 轮的 {artifactDisplayName} 已不存在或无法读取，已跳过。

conversationShare.warning.artifactTypeSk.en: Turn {turnOrdinal}: {artifactDisplayName} ({artifactType}) is not supported and was skipped. Supported types: {allowedFormats}.
conversationShare.warning.artifactTypeSk.zh: 第 {turnOrdinal} 轮的 {artifactDisplayName}（{artifactType}）暂不支持分享，已跳过。当前支持：{allowedFormats}。

conversationShare.warning.artifactChange.en: Turn {turnOrdinal}: {artifactDisplayName} changed before sharing and was skipped.
conversationShare.warning.artifactChange.zh: 第 {turnOrdinal} 轮的 {artifactDisplayName} 在分享前发生变化，已跳过。

conversationShare.partial.empty.en: There are no completed conversations to share
conversationShare.partial.empty.zh: 当前没有已完成、可分享的对话

conversationShare.partial.selectionStage.en: Select completed conversations to share, then continue to the next step.
conversationShare.partial.selectionStage.zh: 勾选要分享的已完成会话，点击下一步继续。

conversationShare.partial.preflightBlock.en: Some content cannot be shared. Fix the issues below first.
conversationShare.partial.preflightBlock.zh: 发现无法分享的内容，请先处理下方问题。

conversationShare.partial.preflightSkipp.en: {count} file(s) will not be included in the share. They will be skipped if you continue.
conversationShare.partial.preflightSkipp.zh: 发现 {count} 个文件不会加入分享链接，继续后会跳过。

conversationShare.partial.preflightDefer.en: Some files cannot be checked yet. They will be verified again when publishing.
conversationShare.partial.preflightDefer.zh: 部分文件暂时无法检查，发布时会再次确认。

conversationShare.partial.continueWithSk.zh: 继续下一步（将跳过 {count} 个文件）

conversationShare.partial.selectionHint.en: Review the title, access, and sensitive-content acknowledgement, then create the link.
conversationShare.partial.selectionHint.zh: 检查标题、访问权限和敏感信息确认后生成链接。

conversationShare.publish.failedDescript.en: Fix the issue below, then retry.
conversationShare.publish.failedDescript.zh: 请根据下方提示修正后重试。

conversationShare.publish.failedFooter.en: Adjust the content before publishing again
conversationShare.publish.failedFooter.zh: 内容需要调整后再发布

conversationShare.progress.checking.en: Waiting for safety checks to finish…
conversationShare.progress.checking.zh: 正在等待安全检查完成…

conversationShare.publicWarning.en: Check conversations, tool inputs and outputs, and artifacts for sensitive information.
conversationShare.publicWarning.zh: 公开前请检查对话、工具输入输出和产物中的敏感信息。

conversationShare.disclosure.description.en: The system does not automatically detect sensitive information.
conversationShare.disclosure.description.zh: 系统不会自动检测敏感信息。

conversationShare.disclosure.checkbox.en: I reviewed the shared content and confirm it contains no sensitive information.
conversationShare.disclosure.checkbox.zh: 我已检查分享内容，确认不包含敏感信息。

conversationShare.disclosure.scope.conve.en: Conversation content: user messages, assistant replies, and task titles
conversationShare.disclosure.scope.conve.zh: 会话内容：用户消息、助手回复、任务标题

conversationShare.disclosure.scope.tools.en: Tool inputs and outputs: commands, parameters, and results
conversationShare.disclosure.scope.tools.zh: 工具输入与输出：命令、参数、返回结果

conversationShare.disclosure.scope.gener.en: Generated content: code, files, and preview content
conversationShare.disclosure.scope.gener.zh: 生成内容：代码、文件、预览内容

conversationShare.disclosure.scope.sensi.en: Credentials, tokens, passwords, private keys, internal addresses, and personal information
conversationShare.disclosure.scope.sensi.zh: 凭证、Token、密码、私钥、内部地址、个人信息

conversationShare.disclosure.scope.note.en: The system does not scan or redact this content automatically. Review each item before sharing.
conversationShare.disclosure.scope.note.zh: 系统不会自动扫描或脱敏，请逐项确认。

conversationShare.import.fallbackRemoteW.en: Imported from share: {title}. The current workspace is remote, which import does not support yet, so the session was created in the local workspace {workspacePath}.
conversationShare.import.fallbackRemoteW.zh: 已从分享导入：{title}。当前工作区是远程的，暂不支持导入，会话已创建在本地工作区 {workspacePath}。

conversationShare.import.fallbackDefault.en: Imported from share: {title}. No target workspace was available, so the session was created in the default workspace {workspacePath}.
conversationShare.import.fallbackDefault.zh: 已从分享导入：{title}。没有可用的目标工作区，会话已创建在默认工作区 {workspacePath}。

conversationShare.import.loginRequired.en: This share cannot be imported anonymously. Sign in to ZCode and try again
conversationShare.import.loginRequired.zh: 该分享暂不支持匿名导入，请登录 ZCode 后重试

conversationShare.import.notFound.en: The share is unavailable for this account
conversationShare.import.notFound.zh: 分享不存在或当前账号无权访问

conversationShare.import.expired.en: The share expired. Ask the author to create a new one
conversationShare.import.expired.zh: 分享已过期，请让分享者重新生成

conversationShare.import.integrityFailed.en: Share file verification failed; import stopped
conversationShare.import.integrityFailed.zh: 分享文件校验失败，已停止导入

conversationShare.import.failed.en: Share import failed. Check your network and retry
conversationShare.import.failed.zh: 分享导入失败，请检查网络后重试

conversationShare.import.integrityFailed.en: Verification failed for shared file {artifactDisplayName}; import stopped. Ask the author to create a new link.
conversationShare.import.integrityFailed.zh: 分享文件 {artifactDisplayName} 校验失败，已停止导入，请让分享者重新生成链接。

conversationShare.import.failedWithArtif.en: Downloading shared file {artifactDisplayName} failed. Check your network and retry.
conversationShare.import.failedWithArtif.zh: 分享文件 {artifactDisplayName} 在下载阶段失败，请检查网络后重试。

pluginCreator.unavailable.en: Plugin Creator is unavailable. Check the connection, then enable or restore Plugin Creator in the marketplace and retry.
pluginCreator.unavailable.zh: 插件创建器暂不可用。请检查连接，并在插件市场启用或恢复“插件创建器”后重试。

quickPick.description.en: Search and run commands available in this workspace.
quickPick.description.zh: 搜索并执行当前工作区可用的命令。

quickPick.find.description.en: Search messages and file changes in the current task.
quickPick.find.description.zh: 搜索当前任务中的消息和文件变更。

quickPick.find.empty.changes.zh: 输入文件路径搜索变更

quickPick.find.scope.tooltip.zh: 切换搜索范围消息/文件

commandCenter.empty.recentChanges.en: No recent changes in current task
commandCenter.empty.recentChanges.zh: 当前任务暂无最近变更

confirmDialog.taskDeleteDescription.en: Task “{taskTitle}” will be removed from this workspace, and the current record cannot be restored.
confirmDialog.taskDeleteDescription.zh: 任务“{taskTitle}”会从当前工作区移除，现有记录无法恢复。

confirmDialog.archivedTaskDeleteDescript.en: Tasks will be removed from the task list and Archive.
confirmDialog.archivedTaskDeleteDescript.zh: 任务将从任务列表和归档列表中移除。

confirmDialog.taskArchiveDescription.en: Task “{taskTitle}” will move to the archive list and can still be restored later.
confirmDialog.taskArchiveDescription.zh: 任务“{taskTitle}”会移入归档列表，之后仍可恢复。

confirmDialog.projectRemoveDescription.en: Project “{projectName}” will be removed from the sidebar, but files on disk will remain untouched.
confirmDialog.projectRemoveDescription.zh: 项目“{projectName}”会从侧边栏移除，但不会删除磁盘上的文件。

taskList.deleteAllArchivedUnavailable.en: These projects cannot be processed right now: {projects}. Try again after reconnecting.
taskList.deleteAllArchivedUnavailable.zh: 以下项目暂时无法处理：{projects}。连接恢复后可再次操作。

taskList.deleteAllArchivedResult.zh: 已删除 {deleted} 个，跳过 {skipped} 个，失败 {failed} 个。

taskList.deleteAllArchivedError.en: The operation or list refresh failed. Refresh to check the remaining tasks.
taskList.deleteAllArchivedError.zh: 操作或列表刷新失败，请刷新后检查剩余任务。

taskList.codexConnectivityUnavailable.en: Codex warmup could not reach {host}. Starting a conversation may fail until the network is available.
taskList.codexConnectivityUnavailable.zh: Codex 预热检测到当前网络无法访问 {host}，后续对话可能无法正常开始

taskList.markAsUnreadFailed.en: Could not mark task as unread

taskList.feedbackOpened.en: Feedback opened with the current task context attached
taskList.feedbackOpened.zh: 已打开反馈，并自动带上当前任务信息

taskList.switchBlockedByModelRestart.en: Model provider switch in progress. Task switching is temporarily disabled.
taskList.switchBlockedByModelRestart.zh: 模型供应商切换中，暂时不能切换任务。

login.description.en: Connect your account to start using ZCode
login.description.zh: 连接账号，开始使用 ZCode

login.oauth.activeProviderHint.en: Current active provider: {provider}. Signing in again replaces the current identity.
login.oauth.activeProviderHint.zh: 当前已登录提供方：{provider}。新登录会替换当前登录身份。

login.oauth.noProviders.en: No account providers are available right now. Please try again later.
login.oauth.noProviders.zh: 当前没有可用的登录提供方，请稍后重试。

login.oauth.button.zai.zh: 连接 Z.ai 继续使用

login.oauth.button.bigmodel.zh: 连接 BigModel 继续使用

login.expired.description.en: To keep your account secure, please sign in again.
login.expired.description.zh: 为了保障账号安全，请重新登录。

login.apiKey.providerMissingError.en: Built-in provider configuration for {provider} was not found. Please try again later.
login.apiKey.providerMissingError.zh: 未找到 {provider} 的内置 provider 配置，请稍后重试。

login.apiKey.saveError.zh: 保存 API key 失败：{error}

login.apiKey.skipError.en: Failed to skip API key setup: {error}
login.apiKey.skipError.zh: 跳过 API key 设置失败：{error}

app.selectFile.en: Select a file to get started

logout.confirm.descriptionWithRunningSes.en: {count} session(s) are currently running. Disconnecting will interrupt them and restart the app.
logout.confirm.descriptionWithRunningSes.zh: 检测到 {count} 个会话正在运行。断开连接会中断这些会话并重启 App。

logout.confirm.descriptionDefault.en: The app will restart after disconnecting. You will need to connect your account again.
logout.confirm.descriptionDefault.zh: 断开连接后会重启 App，之后需要重新连接账号。

sidebar.usage.plan.unavailable.zh: 暂无可展示的权益数据。

sidebar.usage.plan.notConfigured.en: No connected Coding Plan account found.
sidebar.usage.plan.notConfigured.zh: 未找到已连接的编程套餐账号。

sidebar.usage.plan.updateFailed.zh: 可能网络原因，更新失败

sidebar.usage.plan.noLimits.zh: 暂无可展示的额度明细。

sidebar.usage.plan.hidden.en: Provider marked this balance as hidden
sidebar.usage.plan.hidden.zh: 服务端标记该额度不展示

sidebar.usage.plan.zcodeMcpDescription.en: Daily aggregate quota for ZCode built-in plugin MCPs
sidebar.usage.plan.zcodeMcpDescription.zh: ZCode 预置插件 MCP 每日合计额度

browser.addressPlaceholder.en: Enter a URL and press Enter

browser.responsive.dimensionRangeError.zh: 请输入 {min} 到 {max} 之间的整数

browser.elementPicker.start.zh: 选择网页元素加入聊天

browser.desktopOnly.en: Browser pane is available on desktop only
browser.desktopOnly.zh: 浏览器面板仅桌面端可用

browser.empty.en: Paste or type a URL to open a page.
browser.empty.zh: 粘贴或输入 URL 以打开网页。

browser.guestFailed.title.en: The built-in browser failed to start

browser.guestFailed.description.en: The browser process exited before it could display the page. You can retry after checking the system environment.
browser.guestFailed.description.zh: 浏览器进程在显示页面前退出。检查系统环境后可以重试。

browser.invalidUrl.en: Only http, https, file, about, and data URLs are supported

browser.loadError.title.en: This page could not be opened

browser.loadError.certTitle.en: This site's HTTPS certificate is not trusted
browser.loadError.certTitle.zh: 该站点的 HTTPS 证书不受信任

browser.loadError.certHint.en: If you trust this address, enable "Ignore certificate errors" under Settings → Browser → Security, then restart the app to access it.
browser.loadError.certHint.zh: 如确认此地址可信，可在「设置 → 浏览器 → 安全」里开启「忽略证书校验」，再重启 App 后即可访问。

browser.resizeDuringOperationWarning.en: The browser size changed and may affect the current automated action
browser.resizeDuringOperationWarning.zh: 浏览器尺寸发生变化，可能影响当前自动操作

diff.placeholder.description.en: This phase focuses on the right-side Diff panel shell first. Real Git services and command execution will be connected later.
diff.placeholder.description.zh: 当前先完成右侧 Diff 面板的前端壳层，真实 Git service 与命令执行后续再接入。

diff.placeholder.toast.en: The Diff panel is still using UI placeholder mode for now because the Git service is not fully wired up yet.
diff.placeholder.toast.zh: 由于 Git service 还未完全接好，当前 Diff 面板先保留前端占位交互。

diff.loading.description.en: Loading the real diff data from the environment that owns this workspace.
diff.loading.description.zh: 正在从当前 workspace 所在环境读取真实 Diff 数据。

diff.error.title.zh: 读取 Diff 数据失败

diff.error.description.en: Please try again later. Current error: {message}

diff.preview.truncatedLines.en: Diff preview truncated: {count} lines omitted to keep UI responsive.
diff.preview.truncatedLines.zh: Diff 预览已截断：为保持界面流畅，省略了 {count} 行。

sidePane.openTabDescription.en: Choose a tab to open in the side pane.
sidePane.openTabDescription.zh: 选择要在侧边面板中打开的标签。

git.empty.lastTurnTitle.zh: 当前任务还没有上一轮文件改动

git.commit.identityMissing.zh: 尚未接入真实 user.name / user.email 读取，因此提交按钮会保持禁用。

git.commit.noStagedChanges.zh: 当前没有 staged 改动，先从左侧选择文件并暂存。

git.commit.ready.zh: 前端校验已通过，后续接入 service 后即可真正提交。

git.commit.placeholder.en: Enter a commit message (UI placeholder only, no real git commit will run yet)
git.commit.placeholder.zh: 输入 commit message（当前为 UI 占位，不会真正执行 git commit）

git.actionMenu.commitDialog.description.zh: 将当前 workspace 内的未提交更改保存为一次提交。

git.actionMenu.commitDialog.messagePlace.zh: 提交信息（留空将自动生成）

git.actionMenu.commitDialog.messageHelpe.zh: 生成会先填充提交消息，再由你确认提交。

git.actionMenu.commitDialog.error.messag.en: Enter or generate a commit message before committing.
git.actionMenu.commitDialog.error.messag.zh: 请先输入或生成提交消息。

git.actionMenu.commitDialog.error.genera.en: Commit message generation failed. Try again or enter one manually.
git.actionMenu.commitDialog.error.genera.zh: 生成提交消息失败，请重试或手动填写。

git.actionMenu.commitDialog.toast.commit.en: Committed and pushed the current changes
git.actionMenu.commitDialog.toast.commit.zh: 已提交并推送当前更改

git.actionMenu.pushDialog.description.tr.zh: 将当前分支最新提交推送到远程分支。

git.actionMenu.pushDialog.description.un.en: The first push will publish the current branch remotely and set its upstream.
git.actionMenu.pushDialog.description.un.zh: 首次推送会把当前分支发布到远程并设置 upstream。

git.actionMenu.pushDialog.upstreamPendin.en: The first push will automatically create the upstream branch for the current branch.
git.actionMenu.pushDialog.upstreamPendin.zh: 首次推送会自动为当前分支建立上游分支。

git.actionMenu.pushDialog.upToDate.zh: 当前分支没有需要推送的提交。

git.actionMenu.pushDialog.error.summary.zh: 推送失败，请检查错误详情。

git.branchSwitcher.createDialog.descript.zh: 基于当前 HEAD 创建一个新的本地分支，并在创建成功后立即切换过去。

git.branchSwitcher.createDialog.helper.zh: 首版只支持基于当前 HEAD 创建并切换。

git.branchSwitcher.blockedDialog.descrip.en: Your changes to the following files would be overwritten by checkout:
git.branchSwitcher.blockedDialog.descrip.zh: 你对以下文件的更改将被检出操作覆盖：

git.branchSwitcher.blockedDialog.descrip.zh: 以下未跟踪文件会被检出操作覆盖：

git.branchSwitcher.blockedDialog.helper.en: Commit the current changes first, then continue switching branches.
git.branchSwitcher.blockedDialog.helper.zh: 请先提交当前更改，再继续切换分支。

git.branchSwitcher.commitDialog.descript.en: After the commit finishes, switching to {branchName} will continue automatically.
git.branchSwitcher.commitDialog.descript.zh: 提交完成后会自动继续切换到 {branchName}。

git.branchSwitcher.commitDialog.messageP.en: Leave empty to generate a commit message automatically
git.branchSwitcher.commitDialog.messageP.zh: 留空以自动生成提交消息

git.branchSwitcher.commitDialog.messageH.en: This will commit all uncommitted changes inside the current workspace by default.
git.branchSwitcher.commitDialog.messageH.zh: 这次会默认提交当前 workspace 内的全部未提交更改。

git.branchSwitcher.commitDialog.identity.en: No Git commit identity is available yet. Configure user.name and user.email first.

git.branchSwitcher.error.targetBranchNot.en: The target branch does not exist locally yet.
git.branchSwitcher.error.targetBranchNot.zh: 目标分支不存在，或还没有拉取到本地。

git.branchSwitcher.error.trackedOverwrit.en: Switch blocked because tracked files would be overwritten: {paths}{extraPaths}.
git.branchSwitcher.error.trackedOverwrit.zh: 切换失败，以下已跟踪文件会被目标分支覆盖：{paths}{extraPaths}。

git.branchSwitcher.error.untrackedOverwr.en: Switch blocked because untracked files would be overwritten: {paths}{extraPaths}.
git.branchSwitcher.error.untrackedOverwr.zh: 切换失败，以下未跟踪文件会被目标分支覆盖：{paths}{extraPaths}。

git.branchSwitcher.error.conflictsPresen.en: The repository still has unresolved conflicts. Resolve them before switching branches.
git.branchSwitcher.error.conflictsPresen.zh: 当前仓库还有未解决的冲突，先处理完再切换分支。

git.branchSwitcher.error.operationInProg.en: Another Git operation is still in progress. Finish it before switching branches.
git.branchSwitcher.error.operationInProg.zh: 当前仓库还有进行中的 Git 操作，完成后再切换分支。

git.branchSwitcher.error.branchInOtherWo.en: That branch is already checked out in another worktree.
git.branchSwitcher.error.branchInOtherWo.zh: 目标分支已在其他 worktree 中被检出，当前工作区无法直接切换。

feedback.center.description.en: Describe the issue and track progress after submitting.
feedback.center.description.zh: 描述问题即可，提交后可查看处理进展。

feedback.background.defaultDetail.en: Feedback will continue in the background
feedback.background.defaultDetail.zh: 反馈会在后台继续处理

feedback.statusHint.pendingReview.en: We received it and will handle it soon.
feedback.statusHint.pendingReview.zh: 我们已收到，会尽快处理。

feedback.statusHint.needInfo.en: We need a bit more information. Check the team reply below.
feedback.statusHint.needInfo.zh: 还需要你补充一点信息，请看下方官方回复。

feedback.statusHint.accepted.en: Your feedback was accepted. We will schedule a fix or improvement.
feedback.statusHint.accepted.zh: 你的反馈已被采纳，我们会安排修复或改进。

feedback.statusHint.closedByReply.en: The product team replied and closed this feedback. Submit a new one if the issue remains.
feedback.statusHint.closedByReply.zh: 产品经理已回复并关闭此反馈，如仍有问题可以重新提交。

feedback.statusHint.archived.en: The product team replied and closed this feedback. Submit a new one if the issue remains.
feedback.statusHint.archived.zh: 产品经理已回复并关闭此反馈，如仍有问题可以重新提交。

feedback.statusHint.rejected.en: This feedback is not planned for now. You can check the explanation below.
feedback.statusHint.rejected.zh: 这条反馈暂未纳入处理，如有疑问可看下方说明。

feedback.statusHint.inDevelopment.en: We are working on it. Updates will appear below.
feedback.statusHint.inDevelopment.zh: 正在处理中，有进展会通过下方回复同步。

feedback.statusHint.resolved.en: The issue has been fixed and is waiting for release.
feedback.statusHint.resolved.zh: 问题已经处理完成，正在等待版本上线。

feedback.statusHint.released.en: The related fix or improvement is live. Thanks for the feedback.
feedback.statusHint.released.zh: 相关修复或改进已上线，感谢你的反馈。

feedback.tickets.empty.description.en: Send a note whenever you run into an issue. We will sync progress here.
feedback.tickets.empty.description.zh: 遇到问题时随手提一条，我们会同步处理进度。

feedback.tickets.placeholder.title.zh: 选择一条反馈查看详情

feedback.tickets.placeholder.description.en: Replies from our team will appear here. You can also add reproduction steps, screenshots, or logs in the details.
feedback.tickets.placeholder.description.zh: 我们处理工单时的回复会出现在这里，你也可以在详情里补充复现步骤、截图或日志。

feedback.detail.issueCopyFailed.zh: 复制 issue 编号失败

feedback.timeline.syncWhenUpdated.zh: 有进展后会在这里同步

feedback.timeline.empty.en: No activity yet. We will notify you here when there is progress.
feedback.timeline.empty.zh: 暂无动态。处理有进展后，会在这里通知你。

feedback.timeline.event.fullLogUploaded.zh: 完整日志已上传，反馈进入已提交

feedback.timeline.event.agentSubmitted.zh: {name} 通过 Agent 提交反馈

feedback.supplement.description.en: Add reproduction steps, screenshot notes, log snippets, or more clues here.
feedback.supplement.description.zh: 可以直接在这里补充复现步骤、截图说明、日志片段或更多线索。

feedback.supplement.continueDescription.en: You can add reproduction steps, screenshot notes, log snippets, or new clues while viewing the process.
feedback.supplement.continueDescription.zh: 在查看流程时也可以直接补充复现步骤、截图说明、日志片段或新的线索。

feedback.supplement.attachmentLimit.en: You can add up to {count} attachments

feedback.supplement.attachmentTooLarge.en: {name} is over 100 MB and cannot be uploaded yet.
feedback.supplement.attachmentTooLarge.zh: {name} 超过 100 MB，暂时不能上传。

feedback.supplement.placeholder.en: Add more details, paste a screenshot, or add a local file...
feedback.supplement.placeholder.zh: 还有要补充的，可以在这里留言、粘贴截图，或添加本地文件…

feedback.supplement.attachmentHint.en: Supports pasted screenshots or local files. Each attachment must be under 100 MB.
feedback.supplement.attachmentHint.zh: 支持粘贴截图或添加本地文件，单个附件不超过 100 MB。

feedback.type.bug.description.zh: 报错、崩溃、功能不符合预期

feedback.type.usage.description.zh: 操作不清楚、配置不确定

feedback.type.performance.description.en: Lag, slow response, or resource issues
feedback.type.performance.description.zh: 卡顿、响应慢、资源占用异常

feedback.submit.bug.descriptionPlacehold.en: Describe what you ran into: where you clicked, what happened, what you expected, and whether there was an error. We keep your original description and analyze it after submission.
feedback.submit.bug.descriptionPlacehold.zh: 直接写你遇到的问题：点了哪里、发生了什么、期望是什么、有没有报错。我们会保留原始描述，提交后再由后端辅助分析。

feedback.submit.bug.screenshotHint.en: Paste a screenshot, or add a local screenshot as an attachment.
feedback.submit.bug.screenshotHint.zh: 粘贴截图，或添加本地截图作为附件。

feedback.submit.usage.titlePlaceholder.en: Example: Not sure how to configure a remote connection
feedback.submit.usage.titlePlaceholder.zh: 例如：不知道怎么配置远程连接

feedback.submit.usage.descriptionPlaceho.en: Describe what you are trying to do, where you got stuck, what prompt you saw, and how you want us to explain or guide you.
feedback.submit.usage.descriptionPlaceho.zh: 写清楚你正在做什么、卡在哪一步、看到了什么提示、你希望我们怎么解释或引导。

feedback.submit.usage.supplementalDescri.en: Module and model help us locate documentation, guidance, or default configuration issues.
feedback.submit.usage.supplementalDescri.zh: 补充模块和模型，有助于我们定位文档、引导或默认配置问题。

feedback.submit.usage.screenshotHint.en: You can paste a screenshot of the blocked screen.
feedback.submit.usage.screenshotHint.zh: 可以粘贴当前卡住的界面截图。

feedback.submit.usage.missingTitle.zh: 请写一下使用问题标题

feedback.submit.usage.missingDescription.en: Please describe where you are stuck

feedback.submit.feature.titlePlaceholder.en: Example: Support one-click task report export
feedback.submit.feature.titlePlaceholder.zh: 例如：希望支持一键导出任务报告

feedback.submit.feature.descriptionPlace.en: Describe what you want added or improved: the scenario, what is inconvenient now, the ideal behavior, and what it would save you.

feedback.submit.feature.supplementalDesc.en: Choose a module so we can assess priority and impact.
feedback.submit.feature.supplementalDesc.zh: 建议也需要选择模块，方便我们评估优先级和影响范围。

feedback.submit.performance.screenshotHi.en: You can attach loading, stuck, or resource-usage screenshots.
feedback.submit.performance.screenshotHi.zh: 可以贴加载中、卡住或资源占用相关截图。
