feedback.featureRequest.missingRequired.zh: 请填写需求描述和期望的解决方案

feedback.featureRequest.source.en: Workspace Header help menu / Request a feature
feedback.featureRequest.source.zh: Workspace Header 帮助菜单 / 给产品提需求

feedback.featureRequest.submittedToast.en: Request submitted. We will review it carefully.
feedback.featureRequest.submittedToast.zh: 需求已提交，我们会认真评估。

feedback.submission.connectingDetail.en: Screenshots and logs will continue uploading after the ticket is created
feedback.submission.connectingDetail.zh: 创建成功后会继续上传截图和日志

feedback.submission.cancelingCreateDetai.en: Cancel request received. Stopping ticket creation.
feedback.submission.cancelingCreateDetai.zh: 已收到取消请求，正在停止创建反馈。

feedback.submission.submittedToast.en: Feedback submitted. We will review it soon.
feedback.submission.submittedToast.zh: 反馈已提交，我们会尽快处理。

feedback.submission.networkErrorDetail.en: Could not connect to the feedback service. Check your network, VPN, or proxy settings, then try again.
feedback.submission.networkErrorDetail.zh: 无法连接反馈服务，请检查网络、VPN 或代理设置后重试。

feedback.submission.postCreateNetworkErr.en: Feedback was created, but additional materials failed to upload. Open the existing feedback to add the missing files; do not submit it again.
feedback.submission.postCreateNetworkErr.zh: 反馈已创建，但后续材料上传失败。请打开已创建的反馈补充材料，不要重复提交。

feedback.submission.pausingLogDetail.zh: 已收到取消请求，稍等一下。

feedback.submission.exportingLogDetail.en: This may take a few seconds depending on local log size
feedback.submission.exportingLogDetail.zh: 会根据本机日志大小耗时数秒

feedback.submission.logUploadPausedDetai.en: Logs are required for investigation. Please continue the upload.
feedback.submission.logUploadPausedDetai.zh: 日志是定位问题的必需材料，请继续上传。

forms.validation.nameMinLength.en: Name must be at least {min} characters
forms.validation.nameMinLength.zh: 名称至少需要 {min} 个字符

forms.validation.nameMaxLength.zh: 名称不能超过 {max} 个字符

forms.validation.namePattern.en: Name can only contain letters, numbers, and hyphens
forms.validation.namePattern.zh: 名称只能包含字母、数字和连字符

forms.validation.agentNameHint.en: Letters, numbers, and hyphens only, 3-50 characters
forms.validation.agentNameHint.zh: 只能包含字母、数字和连字符，3-50个字符

forms.validation.agentDescriptionHint.zh: 简要描述子智能体的功能

forms.validation.agentSystemPromptHint.en: Define the subagent's behavior and capabilities
forms.validation.agentSystemPromptHint.zh: 定义子智能体的行为和能力

modelSelection.invalidated.fallback.en: The previous model selection is no longer available. Switched to the current default; review it before continuing.
modelSelection.invalidated.fallback.zh: 原来的模型选择已失效，已切换到当前默认模型，请确认后继续。

modelSelection.invalidated.reselect.en: The previous model selection is no longer available. Choose a model again.
modelSelection.invalidated.reselect.zh: 原来的模型选择已失效，请重新选择模型。

cuaPermission.modal.unavailable.en: Couldn't verify the Helper permission status yet (it may still be starting). Check again before opening System Settings.
cuaPermission.modal.unavailable.zh: 暂时无法确认 Helper 权限状态（Helper 可能还在启动）。请重新检查后再打开系统设置。

cuaPermission.live.title.zh: 电脑操作需要 macOS 权限

cuaPermission.live.description.en: A running Computer Use task needs macOS permissions. Open the authorization guide?
cuaPermission.live.description.zh: 正在运行的电脑操作任务需要 macOS 权限，是否前往授权？

cuaPermission.modal.relaunchAppHint.en: Still not working after restarting Helper? Restart ZCode to fully reload the Helper process.
cuaPermission.modal.relaunchAppHint.zh: 重启 Helper 后仍未生效？重启 ZCode 可彻底重载 Helper 进程。

cuaPermission.status.stale.zh: 授权状态需要重新确认

cuaPermission.probeVerifyingHint.en: System permission is present. Verifying real control and screen capture now.
cuaPermission.probeVerifyingHint.zh: 系统授权已存在，正在验证实际控制与截图能力。

cuaPermission.tools.preparing.en: System permissions and local control are ready. Waiting for this session to load Computer Use tools.
cuaPermission.tools.preparing.zh: 系统权限与本机控制能力已就绪，正在等待当前会话加载电脑控制工具。

cuaPermission.grantAlreadySatisfied.en: This permission has already been granted.

cuaPermission.tools.agentUpdateRequired.en: The connected Agent is too old for a safe readiness check. Update or restart it, then check again.
cuaPermission.tools.agentUpdateRequired.zh: 当前 Agent 版本过旧，无法安全检查工具就绪状态。请更新或重启 Agent 后重新检查。

cuaPermission.tools.untrustedRuntime.en: Computer Use tools were found, but they did not come from the verified ZCode plugin. Review the plugin installation, then check again.
cuaPermission.tools.untrustedRuntime.zh: 检测到电脑控制工具，但它们并非来自已校验的 ZCode 官方插件。请检查插件安装后重新验证。

cuaPermission.perm.accessibility.purpose.zh: 读取/驱动 UI 元素 + 合成键鼠输入

cuaPermission.osFloorTitle.en: Computer Use requires macOS {minimum} or later (currently around macOS {current})
cuaPermission.osFloorTitle.zh: 电脑控制功能需要 macOS {minimum} 或更高版本（当前约为 macOS {current}）

cuaPermission.osFloorDescription.en: Please upgrade macOS before using it. Permission setup cannot be completed on older versions.
cuaPermission.osFloorDescription.zh: 请先升级系统后再使用。授权设置在低版本系统上无法完成。

cuaPermission.ready.sessionValidationHin.en: ZCode will verify the Computer Use tools against the exact session when your first session starts.
cuaPermission.ready.sessionValidationHin.zh: 首个会话启动时，ZCode 会针对该会话精确验证电脑控制工具。
